metaDescription: CPT 98980 explained: RTM treatment management with 20 minutes of time and one live interactive contact. Documentation, rate and common billing mistakes.
summary: Monthly RTM management time: at least 20 minutes of reviewing data and managing treatment, including one real-time two-way contact with the patient or caregiver.
time: 20 minutes per calendar month with interactive communication
performer: The billing practitioner or therapist, or staff under general supervision where incident-to billing applies
frequency: Once per patient per month for the base unit
requirements: At least one real-time two-way contact with the patient or caregiver in the month
A time log showing the management minutes
A note linking the data to the changes made to the treatment plan
pitfalls: Counting automated reminders as interactive contact
Logging time with no record of what changed in the plan
conflicts: Not reported in the same month as 98979, the 2026 code for the first 10 minutes of management.

faqs.question: Does an automated message count as interactive communication?
faqs.answer: No. The contact must be real-time and two-way with the patient or caregiver.

faqs.question: Can clinical staff perform the 98980 time?
faqs.answer: Since 2023, CMS allows general supervision for RTM where incident-to billing applies, such as physician, NP and PA practices. Therapist practices generally cannot use incident-to, so the therapist or a supervised assistant must furnish it.
